what: Matched Lichess newcomers: their own change in Lichess blunders per 100 moves between rated 10+0 games 11-40 and 61-160 (preregistration.md 3.6, S6). Read by prereg/verdict.py --newcomers.
binding_if: committed before the start of his game U+1 (41 when U = 40) with 30+ players (verdict.py needs players >= 30); this file: 100 players

rule.candidates: non-BOT players rated 900-1300 (own pre-game rating) in a rated 600+0 game of the database sample, months tried in this order: 2026-09
rule.newcomer: account created at most 60 days before the first rated 10+0 game; at least 160 rated 10+0 games, numbered with prereg measure.py eligible()
rule.blunders: Lichess's own count (players.<colour>.analysis.blunder) on games Lichess analysed; rates per 100 own moves pooled per window with prereg verdict.py ratio()
rule.order: sha256("chess-project-newcomers-2026-10-16|" + user id), ascending; stop at 100 players
rule.mean_change: mean over players of (rate in 61-160 minus rate in 11-40); negative = they improve
rule.drift_sd: sqrt(max(0, sample variance of the change minus mean ratio-method sampling variance))
